fields.Participants: Customer Service, Ecommerce, Logistics, Store Ops

workflows.name: Customer Delivery Damage & Shortage Claim Intake

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs damage/shortage claim from customer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "verify against order, delivery POD, and fulfillment source" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-route of "Customer Service routes claim" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: 24-hr SLA and goodwill authority tiers
Pain Points / Risks: - **Customer-experience risk**: Slow claim handling damages loyalty; mitigated by 24-hr SLA and goodwill authority tiers
System Touchpoints: - Customer claim case (links to VS-13); order/POD lookup (links to VS-10/VS-06); ecommerce messaging

steps.activity: Customer Service logs damage/shortage claim from customer (phone/chat/email/in-store): order, SKU, qty, photo, delivery date, carrier
Customer Service/Ecommerce verify against order, delivery POD, and fulfillment source (store/DC/3PL); determines responsibility indicator
Customer Service routes claim: goodwill replacement/refund (W3035), investigation (W3034), or denial with explanation; communicates to customer

fields.Participants: Trade Sales, Logistics, Project Mgmt, QC, Customer Service

workflows.name: B2B / Trade Delivery Damage Claim Investigation & Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Trade Sales/Project Mgmt investigate B2B claim against delivery POD" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics determine liability" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Trade Sales negotiates resolution with account" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: documented investigation and tiered resolution authority
Pain Points / Risks: - **Relationship risk**: Disputed B2B claims strain trade relationships; mitigated by documented investigation and tiered resolution authority
System Touchpoints: - B2B order/project records (links to VS-11/VS-40); claim case; project billing adjustment (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Trade Sales/Project Mgmt investigate B2B claim against delivery POD, jobsite receipt, and project records; document with photos/witnesses
QC/Logistics determine liability (vendor, carrier, jobsite handling, customer); quantify loss including project-delay impact where applicable
Trade Sales negotiates resolution with account (replacement, credit, price adjustment, retention-money adjustment); coordinates subrogation (W3038)

fields.Participants: Customer Service, Store Ops, Finance, LP
fields.Trigger: Customer claim routed to the goodwill path (W3033 step 3)

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based authorization of "authorize replacement/refund without full investigation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "fulfill replacement (store pick / re-delivery / BOPIS)" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalates anomalies to VS-23" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: authority tiers and LP pattern monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abuse/fraud risk**: Goodwill exploited by fraudsters; mitigated by authority tiers and LP pattern monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Goodwill authorization matrix; replacement order (links to VS-07/VS-10); LP abuse analytics (links to VS-23)

steps.activity: Customer Service applies goodwill authority matrix (value tier, customer lifetime, loyalty tier) to authorize replacement/refund without full investigation
Store Ops/Ecommerce fulfill replacement (store pick / re-delivery / BOPIS); coordinates logistics; updates order
LP samples goodwill authorizations for abuse patterns (serial claimants, fraud rings); escalates anomalies to VS-23; tracks goodwill cost

workflows.name: Damage Claim Refund, Credit Note & Financial Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "account or one-off refund" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-allocate of "allocates cost to damage case with liability flag" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles claim P&L impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-75 (detect and recover freight & receiving damage.)
- operational: liability flag and subrogation follow-through (W3038)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Net-cost risk**: Customer refunds posted without pursuing vendor/carrier recovery inflate damage cost; mitigated by liability flag and subrogation follow-through (W3038)
System Touchpoints: - Refund/credit note (links to W101); AR posting (links to W8); damage case cost ledger

steps.activity: Finance/AR processes refund via original tender or BIR-compliant credit note (links to W101); posts to customer account or one-off refund
Finance allocates cost to damage case with liability flag; offsets recovered amounts from vendor/carrier/insurer subrogation
Finance reconciles claim P&L impact (net of recovery) at month-end; reports unrecovered damage cost to management

workflows.name: Third-Party Delivery Partner (Lalamove / Transportify) Damage Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Customer Service file damage claim with 3PL partner per partner SLA…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track 3PL recovery" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review or partner change" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: partner insurance requirements and SLA penalties
Pain Points / Risks: - **Partner-coverage risk**: 3PL liability cap below value; mitigated by partner insurance requirements and SLA penalties
System Touchpoints: - 3PL partner claim (links to VS-56); damage case; partner scorecard

steps.activity: Logistics/Customer Service file damage claim with 3PL partner per partner SLA within notice window; provides POD, photos, and order
Logistics track 3PL recovery (reimbursement, partner insurance, SLA penalty); reconcile against damage case and customer resolution
Logistics feed 3PL damage performance into partner scorecard (links to VS-56); drives partner performance review or partner change

fields.Participants: Claims Mgr, Vendor Mgmt, Logistics, Finance
fields.Trigger: Customer damage resolved but liability lies with vendor/carrier

workflows.name: Damage Claims Subrogation to Vendor / Carrier

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepares subrogation claim with evidence" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics file vendor claim" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports net damage cost" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: mandatory liability-flag at resolution; operational: liability-flag at resolution
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery-gap risk**: Customer-resolved damage not subrogated; mitigated by mandatory liability-flag at resolution
System Touchpoints: - Subrogation linkage to vendor/carrier claims (W3025/3026); damage case net-cost; insurance reconciliation (W3030)

steps.activity: Claims Mgr identifies customer-resolved damage where root cause is vendor/carrier; prepares subrogation claim with evidence (W3028)
Vendor Mgmt/Logistics file vendor claim (W3025) or carrier claim (W3026) to recover customer-resolution cost
Finance nets subrogation recovery against damage case; reports net damage cost; coordinates with insurance (W3030) to avoid double-recovery

fields.Participants: Supply Chain Analytics, Claims Mgr, Finance, Executives

workflows.name: Enterprise Damage & Claims Recovery Dashboard & KPI Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise damage & claims dashboard" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report KPIs vs. targets" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review damage cost as % of COGS and margin impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
- operational: consolidated damage case ledger and dashboard
Pain Points / Risks: - **Visibility risk**: Damage cost hidden across GL accounts; mitigated by consolidated damage case ledger and dashboard
System Touchpoints: - Enterprise damage/claims dashboard (links to VS-28); executive scorecard

steps.activity: Supply Chain Analytics maintains enterprise damage & claims dashboard: damage rate, claim volume, recovery %, net damage cost, by channel/lane/vendor
Claims Mgr/Finance report KPIs vs. targets (shrinkage <1.5%, recovery %, aging); identify outliers and corrective priorities
Executives review damage cost as % of COGS and margin impact; sponsor systemic initiatives (packaging, lane, partner) where warranted

fields.Participants: FP&A, Supply Chain Analytics, Merchandising, Vendor Mgmt

workflows.name: Damage Cost Allocation, Vendor Recovery Rate & Margin Impact Analysis

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-allocate of "allocates net damage cost to category/vendor/lane/SKU" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports margin impact of damage" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-501 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Damage/Shortage Claims & Recovery Analytics (PA-90.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: Net damage cost not reflected in category margins drives poor decisions; mitigated by full-cost allocation to category/vendor
System Touchpoints: - Margin/category analytics (links to W85/VS-28); damage cost allocation; vendor negotiation (links to VS-03/VS-39)

steps.activity: FP&A allocates net damage cost to category/vendor/lane/SKU; computes vendor recovery rate and unrecovered damage cost
Merchandising/Vendor Mgmt incorporate damage cost and recovery into category margin analysis (links to W85) and vendor negotiation (rebates/allowances)
FP&A reports margin impact of damage; recommends pricing/packaging/sourcing actions to recover net damage cost
